narrative:
## Handover Summary — Rolling Forecast Scenarios

Base, downside and upside scenarios are locked for the next 13 weeks.

## Key Decisions
• Scotland profit index lowered on footfall trend
• Wage settlement downside widened to reflect the confirmed pay floor
• Energy downside narrowed on hedge cover

## Recommendation for Consolidation Phase
Present the base case to the Partnership Board with the downside range alongside it, not in an appendix.
